tools.name: autocomplete_users
tools.description: Find Zendesk users using autocomplete by name prefix, phone, or lookup relationship, with optional filters. Name or phone searches cannot be combined with lookup relationship parameters.

input_schema.title: AutocompleteUsersRequest

name.title: Name
name.description: The name to search for matching users. Returns users whose name starts with the provided value. Cannot be combined with field_id/source.

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: The phone number to search for matching users. Cannot be combined with field_id/source.

dynamic_values.title: Dynamic Values
dynamic_values.description: Dynamic values filter object for lookup relationship autocomplete

filter.title: Filter
filter.description: Filter to apply to autocomplete results. Common values: 'assignable', 'requester', or 'dynamic_values' object.

source.title: Source
source.description: The type of the object referenced by field_id. When provided, must be one of the recognized values: 'zen:user', 'zen:organization', 'zen:ticket', or 'zen:custom_object:CUSTOM_OBJECT_KEY' (also 'zen:article'/'zen:brand' for lookup fields defined on a custom object) — any other value 400s with "Parameter source must be a valid type is required".

field_id.title: Field Id
field_id.description: Field ID for lookup relationship autocomplete. If source is also provided, it must be a recognized type string — an unrecognized value 400s with "Parameter source must be a valid type is required". field_id alone (with no source) is accepted and simply returns no matches. Cannot be combined with name/phone.

input_schema.description:
Request body for autocomplete users search.

name/phone (name-prefix search) and field_id/source (lookup-relationship
search) are two separate, mutually exclusive autocomplete modes. Zendesk
does not document this explicitly, but combining name with field_id/source
returns a 400 'Parameter source must be a valid type is required' error.

tools.name: create_many_tickets
tools.description: Create many tickets in Zendesk in a single request. Accepts an array of up to 100 ticket objects. The operation is handled asynchronously — a background job is queued and you receive a job_status payload with an initial status of 'queued' or 'working'. Poll the job_status URL or use zendesk.get_job_statuses2 to check for completion and view per-ticket results. Use when creating multiple tickets at once or seeding test data.
